# `aitbc ipfs island subscribe`

Subscribe to a private island IPFS network. Submits an IPFS_SUBSCRIPTION transaction that creates or extends an on-chain subscription record. The member can then request the swarm key with `aitbc-cli ipfs island swarm-key`.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc ipfs island subscribe [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallet` | text | — | yes | Wallet name to pay from |
| `--to` | text | — | yes | Island treasury / recipient address |
| `--island-id` | text | — | yes | Island identifier (e.g. ait-localnet-island) |
| `--duration` | integer | `1000` | no | Subscription duration in blocks (default 1000) |
| `--quota` | integer | `1073741824` | no | Quota in bytes (default 1 GiB) |
| `--amount` | decimal | — | yes | Payment amount in AIT |
| `--fee` | decimal | `0.01` | no | Transaction fee in AIT (standard chain fee) |
| `--password-stdin` | flag | `false` | no | Read the wallet password from one line of standard input |
| `--password-file` | file | — | no | Path to a file containing only the wallet password (mode 0600, owned by you) |
| `--password` | text | — | no | Wallet password (deprecated: visible in process lists and shell history; prefer --password-stdin or --password-file) |
| `--rpc-url` | text | — | no | Blockchain RPC URL |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc ipfs island subscribe --wallet <wallet_name> --to <to_address> --island-id <island_id> --amount <amount>
RPC_URL=http://127.0.0.1:8202/rpc
aitbc ipfs island subscribe --wallet <wallet_name> --to <to_address> --island-id <island_id> --amount <amount> --rpc-url "$RPC_URL"
```
